svg.text: A staged batch survives leaving the gesture, a crash and
a restart, so capture resumes it rather than starting over.
One instance per task. The bucket is Important and
Urgent, Not Important and Urgent, or Important and Not
The staged batch survives as a draft. Nothing it
describes takes effect until the batch is committed.
The answer is empty where nothing was left staged. A
draft is kept outside version control.
Chores is never a destination the user picks. Naming no
board at all is what sends a task there. The answer is
empty until the first project exists, and then naming no
board is the only legal capture.
A staged draft is not a commit. It is kept outside version
One request discards a single draft and the whole batch
Capturing a task never creates a board. The batch
throw one away, or all of them
